Our Story

From Cairo.
For Essen.

We searched all of Germany for real Hawawshi. We never found it. So we decided to bring it ourselves — not "inspired by," the real thing.

Crispy Egyptian street bread, hand-stuffed with seasoned beef, grilled until the crust shatters and the inside stays juicy. This is Cairo, brought to Essen.
